description: Choose what may sync code-defined form schemas into this project. "publishable_key" lets the browser-safe `pk_` key sync, which is convenient in development; "trusted_only" requires an `fsync_` token, which is what a production project should use. Changing this changes who may alter live form schemas, so pass confirm=true when the user authorized this action on the specified target. Otherwise ask for their decision. Needs workspace:manage.

confirm.description: Set true when the user has authorized this action on the specified target in the task or workflow. Ask only if that authorization is missing.

name: fillo_set_code_sync_policy
title: Set the code-sync policy
